areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: General objective not direct but relevant; specific objectives, components and SMART indicators; significant resources and high impact for vulnerable youth, older adults, caregivers and minorities.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Relevant specific objective, products and SMART indicator on domestic violence; low resource share and moderate impact; solutions considered efficient.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: General and specific objectives and components directly aligned, with SMART indicators; most resources go here, with high impact and efficient solutions.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Specific objective and products relate through adapted fitness spaces for older adults, but the indicator measures broad active-ageing actions rather than physical activity; low resources, minor impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Specific objective, product and SMART indicators on environmental emergencies and fires; relevant resources, but beneficiaries unclear so impact is minor.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Specific objective, product and SMART indicators on work access for incarcerated and juvenile-justice populations; low resources and minor impact despite efficient solutions.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: No objectives or actions directly tied to public health access and no indicators showing results in this area.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Program targets youth beyond the early-childhood and primary-school age range, so no basis for scoring.

areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Education products for specific confined populations are social inclusion rather than structural improvement of regular secondary, technical or higher education quality.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Actions do not address pension coverage, contributions or financial sustainability; the work-inclusion focus fits the labor area instead.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No objectives or actions directly linked to integrated urban investments and no indicators demonstrating results in this area.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Focus is risk management and disaster response by public-safety bodies, not conservation or restoration; better fitted to disaster resilience.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Efficient solar-powered public lighting is an instrument for situational crime prevention, with local and accessory energy impact rather than energy policy.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: No objectives or actions directly tied to reducing regional inequalities and no indicators showing results in this area.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening of security forces is planned, but no indicators clearly demonstrate results directly related to state capacity.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Digital modernization of public safety is planned, but no indicators clearly demonstrate results directly related to digital government.
